messages:
marco: Heads up — our Go sample app is hitting weird duplicate work under heavy pagination + throttle. saw a spike of 429s then a bunch of identical downstream requests.

marco: I think the paginator is re-requesting page 3 after a 429 and we end up replaying the same items (and re-ingesting).

tanya: Oof. Which limiter are you using? leaky bucket or token-bucket?

marco: token-bucket default from the sdk sample. config is simple: rate=200 req/s, burst=50.

liam: Could be the retry+auth refresh combo. If the token refresh path uses the same client and is blocking, goroutines might retry the same cursor concurrently.

marco: here's pseudocode of how the sample does it:
```go
for {
  page, err := client.List(things, cursor)
  if err == ErrRateLimited { sleep(backoff); continue }
  // process items and update cursor
}
```

tanya: Two issues to watch: 1) whether cursor advancement is idempotent, 2) whether your retry logic dedupes in-flight cursors. If both are false you get replay.

liam: Also check SDK parity: JS SDK has an optional in-flight map for cursors (dedupe by cursor id). Go SDK hasn't got that helper yet AFAIK.

marco: Right — we only saw this in the Go sample during onboarding stress test. JS sample passed.

marco: Any quick mitigation we can suggest in the sample app before we ship a proper SDK fix?

tanya: Short term: 1) make cursor advancement write-before-process (persist last-seen cursor to local state), 2) add jitter+exponential backoff on 429, 3) throttle retries per-cursor with a small in-memory map.

liam: Also, avoid reusing the same HTTP client for auth refresh if refresh triggers heavy sync. spawn a dedicated refresh routine or use singleflight so only one refresh runs at a time.

marco: Good call. I'll patch the sample with singleflight and a simple per-cursor retry guard.

marco: Patch plan: add a map[string]bool in the sample (protected by mutex) mark cursor-inflight; if seen, skip until cursor completes — should cut duplicates 80% in our tests.

sdk-bot: Reminder: create a small RFC in devex/google-docs for Go SDK dedupe helper. Template: problem, suggested API, compatibility note.

tanya: @marco can you include a small benchmark in the sample (burst 2k reqs) so customers see the behavior?

marco: yes — will add a simple bench harness and results in the PR.

ops-bot: deploy notice: canary build for sample-app updated (build/4578).

liam: After patch, we should also add an example in the SDK README: "handling paginated retries without replay" — show singleflight + cursor guard.

marco: I'll draft the README snippet and the PR targeting devex/sample-apps repo.

tanya: thanks, team. once marco's PR is up i'll try to reproduce again on our 1k bursts. :thumbsup:
